title: Megurine Luka — An Exhilarating Stage!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh?
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is Miku going to visit those other SEKAI again?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (She's been acting this way for a while now.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Ever since the incidents with those black fragments, she's been so worried.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I might also go see how the trees in those SEKAI are doing. Starting with...
Street SEKAI
Plaza

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's see... The tree in this SEKAI should be...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, everyone else is here too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
What are they talking about?
They seem to be having a bit of an argument...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Seriously...
I asked if you actually watered the tree, didn't I?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
And you said you'd do it “later”.
But you haven't!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sorry! I had it in mind right up until I went to get lunch at the cafe, and then it flew right out of my head.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Having lunch and watering the tree have nothing to do with each other!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I mean, when you're eating delicious food, it's only natural to only think about how yummy it is, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me!
KAITO forgot to water the tree the other day, too, and he—

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, I'm not letting you shift the blame onto someone else. It was your turn, and you forgot.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Urgh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Now I see. She's being scolded because she forgot to water the tree.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But knowing her, instead of scolding her, they should be...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But you won't make the same mistake again, right, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Remember when I showed you how to make that little dish the other day? You mastered it after just one attempt.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You have a very good memory, so you won't forget to water it next time, yes?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Of course!
After all, I can do anything if I put my mind to it♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
So, don't worry about my next turn!
I promise to do a perfect job when watering it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, please do.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Nicely done, cafemaster MEIKO.
You know my counterpart's personality so well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well, it's probably more accurate to say that she knows how to look after this Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In that sense, the theater me is also...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Aha! There you are, Luka!
I need to talk to you about our next show.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hm...? MEIKO?
Did you come to let me nap on your lap?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh? No, I'm here to discuss the show...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Thank you... Hehe.
I'm sure my dreams will be even better now... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh? Luka? Lukaaa!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Honestly...
Just for a little bit, okay?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It seems like she's always being pampered or looked after by MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Meanwhile, the me from Mafuyu's SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO, I just came up with a great idea. Want to hear it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You can tell me...
But don't expect a reaction.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, but your reaction is what I'm looking forward to the most.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, you'll just have to say something worth reacting to.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It sounds like you've already decided to ignore more. Fine, then. I'll just go find Miku and the others.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The MEIKO from that SEKAI knows how to skillfully deal with her antics.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Which goes to show how well she understands her Luka's personality.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That understanding and her ability to handle antics reminds me of cafemaster MEIKO and theater MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I just discovered a surprising similarity.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Now I feel like seeing the me from the other SEKAI, too...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Which one should I visit next?
